POSITION ENGINE
textPreview: POSITION ENGINE

text: The quantities answer two separate questions
textPreview: The quantities answer two separate questions

text: The commercial position comes from orders. Physical on-hand comes from stock lots.
textPreview: The commercial position comes from orders. Physical on-hand comes from stock lots.

text: Commercial open
textPreview: Commercial open

text: Purchased quantity minus total confirmed sold quantity. Positive is long exposure, negative is short.
textPreview: Purchased quantity minus total confirmed sold quantity. Positive is long exposure, negative is short.

text: Physical on hand
textPreview: Physical on hand

text: Quantity from lots linked through validated incoming stock pickings.
textPreview: Quantity from lots linked through validated incoming stock pickings.

text: They can differ while receipts or deliveries are still in progress.

P&L ENGINE
textPreview: P&L ENGINE

text: Matched units and open units are priced separately
textPreview: Matched units and open units are priced separately

text: All monetary calculations use the reporting currency.
textPreview: All monetary calculations use the reporting currency.

text: Average cost per unit
textPreview: Average cost per unit

text: (Purchase quantity × converted purchase price + additional costs) ÷ purchase quantity
textPreview: (Purchase quantity × converted purchase price + additional costs) ÷ purchase quantity

text: Realized P&L
textPreview: Realized P&L

text: Converted sales value less average cost of the matched quantity.
textPreview: Converted sales value less average cost of the matched quantity.

text: Unrealized P&L
textPreview: Unrealized P&L

text: Open quantity × spread between market price and cost for a long position.
textPreview: Open quantity × spread between market price and cost for a long position.

text: Total P&L = realized + unrealized + additional revenue.
textPreview: Total P&L = realized + unrealized + additional revenue.

text: Source: product/commodity_trading/ele_trading/README.md, section 6. For short positions the unrealized formula uses sale price less market price. Without a market price, a long position shows a conservative negative cost exposure placeholder; a short shows zero.
